verdict.rationale: Vanta documents some pieces of a manual-evidence workflow: you can attach an evidence file to a document and submit it for review (vanta-docs-31), bulk-assign owners to resources (vanta-docs-23), and make a specific user accountable for a control (vanta-docs-30). The only reminder evidence is for risk assessments, not evidence artifacts (vanta-docs-22), and nothing addresses due dates or expiry on manual artifacts. missing for 10: per-artifact due dates, renewal reminders for manual evidence, expiry/staleness tracking, explicit owner assignment on documents themselves, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
